dedupe_keys.name: powger a highly resolved power system model of germany for remix

description: PowGER is a highly resolved model data set of the German power system for REMix, the energy system optimisation framework of the German Aerospace Center (DLR). It was published on B2SHARE by Jan Buschmann and Karl-Kiên Cao of DLR and Shima Sasanpour. It combines renewable plants from Open Power System Data, conventional and hydro plants from the powerplantmatching data set, demand distributed by the GEOSTAT 1 km population grid, German load and physical cross-border flows from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, renewable time series and capacity potentials from EnDat, and transmission nodes and links from the PyPSA-Eur GridKit extract of the ENTSO-E map, with two missing links filled manually and some offshore nodes removed. A 2030 variant drops nuclear plants and coal and lignite plants commissioned before 1990, using 2021 trade, 2018 wind and solar and 2011 run-of-river series. Coverage is Germany at transmission node level. The data are downloadable from B2SHARE (published March 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: sources date from 2011 to 2021 and some links were edited by hand. Simulation uses are capacity expansion and dispatch optimisation of the German grid in REMix. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
